entities.name: PMID:25070806
observations: 2015 study tested vitamin D and LMWH in human first-trimester HTR8 trophoblast cells and primary trophoblast cultures; cytokines and angiogenic factors were measured by ELISA.

entities.name: Vitamin D trophoblast effects
observations: Vitamin D alone or with LMWH attenuated aPL-induced trophoblast inflammatory response in HTR8 cells and primary cultures; vitamin D significantly inhibited LMWH-induced sFlt-1 release.
Vitamin D did not alter aPL-mediated modulation of angiogenic factors in primary trophoblasts; evidence is in vitro, not a demonstrated clinical treatment effect.

entities.name: Vitamin D
observations: Tested in human trophoblast cultures for effects on aPL-induced inflammation and LMWH-induced sFlt-1 secretion.

entities.name: aPL-induced trophoblast inflammation
observations: Antiphospholipid antibodies induced an inflammatory response in human trophoblast cultures; vitamin D attenuated this response.

entities.name: sFlt-1
observations: LMWH-induced release by human trophoblast was significantly inhibited by vitamin D in vitro.
